finding.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
finding.trigger: If the input 'id' is crafted to include a null byte (\0), the strncpy function will stop copying early, leading to incomplete initialization of the _id array.
finding.assumptions: The class might be part of a larger system that could potentially execute commands based on the _id field, either directly or through some other mechanism.
